customElements.description: Output Validator gates publication. Per-manager Daily Brief: Persian + JSON.
customElements.name: Validation & Daily Brief

properties.responsibility.detail: Final deterministic checks are separate from pre-analysis access checks. Validate numbers against registered SQL with canonical rounding, recipient access, duplicate/escalation consistency, evidence quality, confidence, unsupported causal claims and output contracts. Only successful validation permits publication. Rejected drafts return to Report Writer within the existing execution grant; exhausted limits produce an explicit failure. Each immutable manager package contains at most five important issues, relevant KPIs, pending decisions, options, open follow-ups and query references in Persian and corresponding JSON. Publication outcomes are independent; partial failure does not satisfy ten-valid-report acceptance. Interactive answers pass their own QA contract and access checks without rewriting a published morning report.

relationships.description: Valid outputs
Bounded rewrite

customElements.name: Role-Based Report Generation

properties.responsibility.detail: Builds consistent role-specific reports from the common Shared Insight source and authorized projections. Manager goals guide report emphasis. Employee task details remain limited to the direct supervisor. Uses the existing Agent only for bounded language drafting; a separate deep investigation per manager is not required. Interactive Q&A is a separate output path and contract.

relationships.description: Drafts

customElements.description: One bounded AI Agent; LLM Gateway; Shared Insight Brief.
customElements.name: AI Analysis & Shared Insight

properties.responsibility.detail: Investigates selected authorized evidence under execution and cost limits. Shared Insights retain registered SQL references, possible causes, confidence, alternatives, options and prior decisions. A causal hypothesis requires at least two independent evidence groups; correlation alone proves no cause. Reuses permitted analysis across managers. Model routing remains provider-neutral; Q14 and Q17 remain open.

relationships.description: Shared Insight Brief
Q&A draft

customElements.description: Access Policy; Query Gateway; Evidence Service. Scoped read-only tools / SQL.
customElements.name: Authorized Evidence

properties.responsibility.detail: Server-side identity and role/row/column policies apply before evidence reaches the Agent or model. Uses predefined tools and constrained read-only Text-to-SQL with validation, limits and registered query results. Authorized manager focus guides evidence selection without widening access. Serves verified analytical observations, approved upload revisions and decision memory. Validated uploads can support interactive answers before the next nightly report.

relationships.description: Authorized evidence

customElements.description: KPI Engine; Workflow Engine (WF1-WF3); Signal Engine. No LLM.
customElements.name: Deterministic Analytics

properties.responsibility.detail: The 55 canonical KPI definitions execute in PostgreSQL over reproducible snapshots. Workflow reconstruction supplies verified process observations. Deterministic rules evaluate deviations, suppress duplicates, assign ownership and escalate. Versioned goals, targets, thresholds, priorities and escalation rules shape signal evaluation, ranking and selection before AI investigation. PostgreSQL equivalence and detailed signal boundaries remain open.

relationships.description: Observations

customElements.description: Ingestion, quality, snapshots. Protected Raw File Storage; PostgreSQL only.

Published history is immutable.
